headline: Autonomous Driving Breakthrough: Autobrains Expands Nvidia Partnership, Enabling Real-Time On-Vehicle Inference Without Running Full-Scale Models
reason: This breakthrough addresses a key challenge in L4 autonomous driving by enabling real-time on-vehicle inference using specialized driving agents, rather than requiring full large models. This reduces computing burden and improves latency, accelerating commercialization of high-level autonomous driving.

headline: Yale scientists reveal what really slows aging and what doesn't
reason: New research from Yale, published in Nature Medicine, identifies prescription medications (like metformin and semaglutide), healthy eating, and exercise as effective in reducing biological age markers. Crucially, it finds popular anti-aging supplements largely ineffective, providing actionable, human-centric protocols based on robust analysis of 51 studies.

headline: This Week in Review | Market Volatility, Q3 Earnings, US Inflation (Nov. 13, 2026)
reason: This report provides a concise overview of significant macroeconomic shifts including recent market volatility driven by factors like Q3 earnings and US inflation data. It offers analysis on why these movements are occurring, detailing how strong corporate results are met with skepticism and the implications of higher-than-expected inflation.

headline: OpenAI Scraps Standalone Robotics Team as General-Purpose Models "Take Over" the Embodied AI Race
reason: OpenAI has dissolved its dedicated robotics research team, integrating staff into core research as general-purpose models like GPT-6 Astra demonstrate the ability to directly control robots. This signals a major architectural shift where foundational AI models are expected to drive robotics, accelerating development in embodied AI and highlighting the growing capabilities of LLMs in physical environments.

headline: Carney unveils forest pledge after skipping two COP summits
reason: Canada's Prime Minister Mark Carney announced a significant pledge of up to $560 million over four years to the Tropical Forest Forever Facility, a new international fund aimed at protecting tropical forests and biodiversity in over 70 countries. This represents a high-impact positive development for climate action and global environmental conservation.
